AMENDMENT_1_Q3_OVERSTATEMENT.v1_said: Q3 cell_state as the state object: CONTRADICTED
AMENDMENT_1_Q3_OVERSTATEMENT.v2_says: Q3 cell_state as designated global scientific state: UNQUALIFIED__NOT_IDENTIFIED_BY_THE_OBJECTIVE
AMENDMENT_1_Q3_OVERSTATEMENT.what_was_overstated: V1 asserted that 'a degenerate cell_state would not by itself raise the loss'. That is an ablation result. No ablation was run. It was stated as a finding and it was not one.

mechanism_verified_in_source_this_turn.ordering: the cell token is concatenated BEFORE the block loop, so it participates in self-attention in all six token-preserving blocks alongside every gene token
mechanism_verified_in_source_this_turn.consequence: gene_states are tokens[:,1:] and are computed in the same attention as the cell token. Gradients from the gene-block loss therefore DO reach pathways involving the cell token. cell_state is not gradient-isolated.

what_still_stands_from_V1: no loss term designates cell_state as the global scientific state
the JEPA target is teacher gene_states, not teacher cell_state
cell_state is not a sufficient statistic by construction: the predictor also receives every student gene state, so nothing forces the cell token to carry the information
the one objective that WOULD identify cell_state, teacher_student_relational_target_v2, is inactive and an audit asserts its absence
AMENDMENT_1_Q3_OVERSTATEMENT.the_precise_distinction: 'participates in the computation' is established. 'carries the cell-specific information' is untested. V1 conflated them.

AMENDMENT_2_NEW_PREMISE_Q7.question: Does a single global cell vector need to exist at all?
AMENDMENT_2_NEW_PREMISE_Q7.statement: a token-preserving architecture may naturally learn a SET-VALUED cell representation -- the configuration of contextualized gene states -- rather than compressing a cell into one sufficient statistic. Biology may favour that: inflammatory, synaptic, stress, metabolic and lineage programs are modular.

three_candidate_scientific_objects_to_co.what: the set of contextualized gene states
a learned or post-hoc low-rank subspace / program set over {h_g}

AMENDMENT_2_NEW_PREMISE_Q7.why_the_third_may_reconcile_the_project: 160 stays token width, the network keeps its distributed gene representation, and biological dimensionality is DISCOVERED as stable program/subspace rank instead of being equated to an architectural width. This is consistent with the ledger's separation of D_shared/D_private/D_total/D_obs from d_gene.

A synthetic substrate built over the canonical address space is therefore constructible today.

effect_on_Q6.correction: a non-circular route exists in principle: synthesize over the canonical 41,238 addresses and evaluate a real checkpoint. What blocks it today is that no LEARNED checkpoint exists -- only a 10-update engineering smoke.

AMENDMENT_4_THE_PROPOSED_EXPERIMENT_PROG.program_reviewed: six representation-role identifiability experiments: cell-token necessity, cell-token causal participation inside the encoder, gene-state sufficiency, cell-state sufficiency, identity-only shortcut, u0 versus learned
AMENDMENT_4_THE_PROPOSED_EXPERIMENT_PROG.agreement: switching the qualified object to the gene-block representation now would be a second premature freeze. Gene-block state is the directly supervised object but may be dominated by gene identity. The question of WHERE the trained model stores cell-specific information must be answered first.

BLOCKER.why_it_blocks: experiment 6 is explicitly 'at initialization and at the frozen learned checkpoint', and experiments 1-5 are only interpretable as 'what training added' against that contrast. At 10 updates the checkpoint and u0 are nearly the same model, so the contrast axis carries almost no signal.
BLOCKER.what_running_1-5_on_it_would_measure: where an essentially untrained transformer puts information -- a fact about attention architecture, not about JEPA
BLOCKER.the_failure_mode_this_avoids: a statistically clean answer to an experiment that was not the experiment intended. This is the S99 pattern.

WHAT_IS_EXECUTABLE_TODAY_UNDER_TRAINING_.the_u0_baseline_arm: experiments 1-5 at initialization, and at the 10-update checkpoint, reported as the BASELINE arm of experiment 6 and labelled as such
WHAT_IS_EXECUTABLE_TODAY_UNDER_TRAINING_.value: it is a genuine prospective deliverable: it fixes the initialization reference before any trained checkpoint exists, so the later comparison cannot be accused of choosing its baseline after seeing the outcome
WHAT_IS_EXECUTABLE_TODAY_UNDER_TRAINING_.it_must_not_be_called: an answer to where JEPA put the cell-specific information

GOVERNANCE_FLAG_ON_EXPERIMENTS_4_AND_5.observation: GeneAnchorDecoder exists and its docstring is 'Two bilinear heads that decode hidden genes only through z_cell'. It is NOT present in the checkpoint's saved state dicts, so it has never been trained.
two_separate_issues: AGENTS.md states the incumbent CELL + hidden-gene identity -> hidden RNA value/detection anchor is REJECTED as an encoder objective. Using it read-only as a probe does not violate that, but the artifact must say which it is.

a cell-state-sufficiency probe has to be FITTED. Fitting a head on a frozen encoder is still an optimization step and is not obviously inside TRAINING = OFF. This needs an explicit authorization decision before the experiment, not after.

S117.defect: I twice scanned for an IPB checkpoint and twice missed a 54.5 MB one in exports/. The first scan was scoped to results/, the second used a find expression whose -o branches did not bind as intended. I was one step from recording that no canonical-vocabulary checkpoint exists.
S117.caught: BEFORE_PUBLICATION, by widening to an exhaustive content scan
S117.why_it_matters: a false absence is the specific error this project has a standing rule against. Had it been published, Q2 and Q6 would have been wrong in the direction that makes the project look more blocked than it is.
S117.fix: content-scan every candidate file; never conclude absence from a scoped search

S118.defect: V1's Q3 asserted an ablation result without running an ablation. The sentence 'a degenerate cell_state would not by itself raise the loss' reads as a measurement and is an inference from the loss expression alone.
S118.caught: AFTER_PUBLICATION, by the external reviewer, not by my own lane
S118.why_my_lane_missed_it: I checked what the loss targets and did not ask what the architecture lets gradients reach. Reading a loss function is not an ablation.
S118.generalization: any claim that a component is unconstrained requires an intervention on that component, not a reading of the objective
